scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "bgRed.bold,bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" --names "BACKEND,USER-APP,HOSPITAL" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:hospital"
